question: Can vast material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: That wealth could fill an ocean with jewels
Such wealth is contrasted with the teaching
inference: Even possession of an ocean filled with jewels is not sufficient reason to give it.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear transmitted form
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels, it would not be enough.
